spray_rain.title: Do Not Spray Pesticides or Fertiliser
spray_rain.text: Rain probability is 60% or higher within the next 24 hours. Rain will wash away applied chemicals into drainage, wasting inputs. Postpone spraying until skies clear.

skip_irrigation.title: Skip Field Irrigation
skip_irrigation.reason: {rain} mm total rainfall expected over next 2 days
skip_irrigation.text: Substantial precipitation ({rain} mm) is forecast over the next 48 hours. Withhold canal or tubewell irrigation to prevent root waterlogging and soil nutrient leaching.

high_wind.title: High Wind Alert: Avoid Chemical Spraying
high_wind.text: Strong winds above 30 km/h cause severe droplet drift, reducing pesticide efficacy and endangering adjacent crops. Carry out foliar applications only during early morning calm hours.

heat_stress.title: Heat Stress Alert: Evening Irrigation Needed
heat_stress.text: Extreme heat condition ({temp}°C) can cause flower drop and stunted vegetative growth. Irrigate crops during evening hours to maintain rhizosphere moisture, and shade young saplings.

frost_risk.title: Frost Warning
frost_risk.text: Near-freezing nighttime minimum ({temp}°C) creates severe frost risk for winter crops like potato, tomato, and mustard. Provide light evening irrigation and cover delicate nursery beds with straw or polythene.

favorable_weather.title: Good Conditions for Normal Field Work
favorable_weather.reason: Moderate temperatures, low wind & steady conditions
favorable_weather.text: Weather parameters remain favorable over the next 3 days. Proceed with scheduled weeding, fertilizer dressing, intercultural operations, and crop harvesting.
